$schema: Unit title and note overrides for course.zh.json (Phase 9 §1). Reviewable data, hand-edited like topics.json and overrides.json; the build merges it over the generated draft.
$notes: titles: unitId -> replacement title, when the drafted dominant-topic title reads wrong.
notes:  unitId -> one-sentence pattern observation shown on the unit. Authored only for
units that introduce a word whose pattern is worth naming; topical vocab units
(Food, Places, People) genuinely have no single pattern and get none.
Unit ids are stable once shipped (Phase 9 §1), so keying by id is safe.

notes.u001: 吗 at the end of a statement turns it into a yes/no question.
notes.u002: 会 is a learned ability; 能 is a circumstantial possibility.
notes.u003: 呢 bounces a question back (你呢?) or marks "what about…".
notes.u004: 有 is "to have" and "there is" — negate it with 没有, never 不有.
notes.u005: 这 "this" and 那 "that" take a measure word before the noun: 这本书.
notes.u008: 着 after a verb marks an ongoing state: 开着门.
notes.u015: 应该 "should" goes before the verb: 你应该去.
notes.u066: 个 is the default measure word — use it when unsure which one a noun takes.
notes.u067: 了 after a verb marks a completed or changed action.
notes.u068: 能 asks or grants possibility: 能帮我吗?
notes.u069: 想 is "would like to"; 要 is a firmer "want to / will".
notes.u070: 还 is "still / also"; 再 is "again", for an action not yet repeated.
notes.u071: 比 compares: A 比 B + adjective — 我比你高.
notes.u072: 就 says something happens sooner or easily; 才 that it takes longer.
notes.u073: 让 "to let / make someone do" takes a person, then a verb: 让我看看.
notes.u074: 最 marks the superlative: 最好 "best".
notes.u157: 几 asks "how many" for small counts, 多少 for larger or open ones.
notes.u158: 请 before a verb makes a polite request: 请坐.
notes.u160: 虽然… 但是… keeps both halves of "although… still…".
notes.u243: 从… 到… traces "from… to…" in space or time.
